summary: M0 model-only verdict: MONITOR @ 0.68. Ten of eleven sign-ins form a consistent baseline matching the case context (faculty abroad + known device + VPN): same device LT-3104, same IP 89.180.44.17 (MEO, Lisbon, PT), via vpn-edge-02, across mail and lms, all successful with mfa_prompt_count 0. The single outlier is a successful mail login from 193.140.10.21 (Turkcell, Manisa, TR) with no device_id and no VPN appliance, occurring ~32 minutes before the first Portugal VPN login—implausible travel if the same person. There are no mail events, no failed authentications, no MFA fatigue, and no post-auth activity to confirm takeover. The anomalous event is unexplained but isolated: not confirmed compromise (contain), not cleanly explained (benign), and no evidence of exposure/data access requiring immediate escalation. Watch for repetition.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
